relations.justification: Tool-making presupposes the basic infrastructure — power, water, shelter — that makes sustained work possible.
Improvised tooling requires maintenance skill; a tool made from salvage degrades faster than one that was manufactured.
Field chemistry specialises chemistry to what can be done without laboratory infrastructure.
Medicine production depends on the field chemistry that produces its reagents and solvents.
Antiseptic preparation depends on the water-treatment chemistry that makes clean water available in the first place.
Rationing requires a decision structure with enough legitimacy that the allocation is accepted; without it the rule is not followed.
